people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

translations.web: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.
translations.bsb: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
translations.kjv: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
translations.asv: And he sent away the multitudes, and entered into the boat, and came into the borders of Magadan.
